content:
<!-- B"H
Boruch Hashem
Blessed is He

The Awtsmoos lets a working studio receive atmosphere without sacrificing measurable truth; Awtsmoos.com records glass, motion, onboarding, provider links, and browser proof so future polish can grow from evidence instead of taste alone.
-->

# Premium Polish Verification

## Release identity

- Premium polish commit: `84667872befb4810ba695fffbc825f1543b07a4e`.
- Parent: `2fcf49b3cc2d47ae6bcd30ad5acd66da07424ecf`.
- Push: normal fast-forward to `origin/main`; never force pushed.
- Commit scope: 13 Olam app files only.
- Original shared worktree retained its unrelated local HEAD and 105 staged files.

## Visual polish delivered

- Animated ambient gradient orbs behind the shell.
- Real glass surfaces using blur, saturation, translucent borders, inset highlights, and layered shadows.
- Glass header and bottom navigation.
- Gradient hero/page headings and glowing brand orb.
- Staggered card/page entrance animation.
- Generate-button light sweep when enabled.
- Provider-status pulse and richer selected navigation/mode states.
- Hover lift/glow for templates, workflow cards, official links, and asset actions.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` disables nonessential motion.

## Onboarding delivered

- Three-step Create guide: Describe, Guide, Review.
- Prompt formula: Subject + Action + Camera + Light + Atmosphere + Audio.
- Paste Prompt and one-tap templates remain prominent.
- Frame/image/video/audio reference guidance remains intact.

## MiniMax setup delivered

Official destinations are centralized in `scripts/config/minimaxLinks.js`:

- API Keys: `https://platform.minimax.io/console/access`.
- H3 video docs: `https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/video-generation`.
- Balance: `https://platform.minimax.io/console/recharge-records`.

Create's missing-key banner links to the official MiniMax API Keys page. Settings explains:

1. Create a pay-as-you-go API key.
2. Configure `MINIMAX_API_KEY` on the Awtsmoos server.
3. Restart or redeploy, then let Olam re-detect provider readiness.

The UI warns never to expose the key in HTML, JavaScript, screenshots, browser storage, or chat logs. No password/secret input exists in browser UI.

## Automated verification

- Every Olam file: <=120 lines.
- JavaScript syntax: pass.
- Node suite: 19 passed, 0 failed.
- Official-link, reduced-motion, and secret-input gates: pass.

## Local premium browser verification

Fresh 360x800 Chrome proved:

- onboarding and three workflow cards render
- computed glass `backdrop-filter` is active
- brand orb animation is active
- official API-key link is exact
- templates preserve textarea identity/focus
- reference instructions remain available
- Estimated Cost does not overlap Generate
- submission panel clears bottom navigation
- Settings contains pay-as-you-go, `MINIMAX_API_KEY`, and security instructions
- no password input exists
- 360px, 768px, and 1440px stay overflow-free
- no captured console errors or failed HTTP responses

The local gate printed `PREMIUM_FINAL_LOCAL_BROWSER_PASS`.

## Production deployment and verification

Canonical deploy fast-forwarded production to `84667872befb4810ba695fffbc825f1543b07a4e` and emitted `CANONICAL_SERVER_ACTIVE` and `CANONICAL_DEPLOY_OK`.

A fresh production Chrome profile fetched the new MiniMax-link and glass assets and printed:

`PASS browser smoke: glass, motion, onboarding, MiniMax setup, templates, references, no overlap`

followed by `PUBLIC_PREMIUM_POLISH_PASS`.

## External boundary

Production still does not contain the third-party `MINIMAX_API_KEY`. The UI now makes the official acquisition/setup path explicit, but the credential itself must be supplied by an authorized operator.
